name: improvy-functions
description: Improvy's server side: the Stripe checkout for Pro on the website, and the webhook that turns a payment into an entitlement the app honours.

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check lib/entitlements.js && node --check lib/catalog.js

dependencies.//: @google-cloud/firestore is what firebase-admin/firestore loads. firebase-admin declares it OPTIONAL, and an optional dependency npm decides to skip is skipped in silence — the deploy then fails analysing the code with Cannot find module, on a machine where nothing is wrong. Named here so it is not optional.
